description: Saves the approved review-request texts as a draft campaign and reserves the listed customers. Requires the client owner, the sms:write scope, accepted set to true and the fingerprint from preview_review. It sends nothing; launch_review sends it.

accepted.description: Must be true to confirm the owner approves the exact texts and recipients.

expectedRevision.description: The installation revision you last read. The call is rejected if the installation has changed since.

fromNumber.description: The business number to send from (E.164).

installationId.description: The agency package installation to act on.

milestones.description: The same milestones used in preview_review.

minimumDays.description: The same minimumDays used in preview_review.

name: agency_care_prepare_review
title: Prepare Review Request Campaign
